faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Government of Mizoram, General Administration Department (GAD Mizoram) for filling up state-level commissioner positions in Mizoram.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are announced under GAD Mizoram Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the post of State Information Commissioner in this recruitment drive released by the General Administration Department.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the completed offline application form along with relevant documents is 12 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for GAD Mizoram State Information Commissioner post?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted strictly through offline mode. Candidates need to obtain the proforma and send it to the designated office address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. Where can I obtain the application form proforma?
faq.answer: You can obtain the application form proforma either from the office of GAD, Room No. 134, First Floor, Mizoram Secretariat Building, MINECO, Khatla, Aizawl or download it from the official website.

faq.question: Q6. What is the required qualification for the State Information Commissioner post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess eminence in public life with wide knowledge and experience in law, science and technology, social service, management, journalism, mass media, or administration and governance.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee required to apply for this job?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification for submitting the application form for the State Information Commissioner post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary structure for the State Information Commissioner?
faq.answer: The salary and allowances for the selected candidate will be provided strictly as per the provisions of the RTI Act, 2005 and the relevant Rules of 2019.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website to check updates regarding this notification?
faq.answer: Candidates can visit the official website of the General Administration Department at https://gad.mizoram.gov.in for all official announcements, updates, and notifications.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment notification?
faq.answer: The official recruitment notification has been published under the advertisement number F-13011/1/2026-GAD dated 28 September 2026 issued by GAD Mizoram.
